source: Merged PRs of google-gemini/gemini-cli (review history via the GitHub API)

metric_definitions.label: accuracy
metric_definitions.basis: plain binary reading: P(true) >= 0.5; correct / answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: F1
metric_definitions.basis: plain binary reading: P(true) >= 0.5; harmonic mean of precision and recall over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: precision
metric_definitions.basis: plain binary reading: P(true) >= 0.5; true positives / predicted positives among answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: recall
metric_definitions.basis: plain binary reading: P(true) >= 0.5; true positives / labelled positives among answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: AUROC
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; binary positive-vs-negative AUROC over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: Brier score
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; binary Brier score over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: ECE
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; calibration of answer correctness over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: loss per case (miss 1, false alarm 1)
metric_definitions.basis: configured tiebreak objective; primary CV chosen rule; denominator: answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: coverage (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed accepted / answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accepted accuracy (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed correct accepted / accepted labelled dev cases

notices: development cases only; the held-out test share was not scored or exposed in this comparison
constraints are reference metadata; this comparison does not filter or select candidates
